ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with an approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black central region extending from the peduncle; mid-sections exhibit dense black-on-white stippling; distal lobes feature high-intensity white backgrounds with localized clusters of fine black pixels and solid black leading-edge borders.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire boundary; irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; most pronounced jaggedness occurs at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, slightly upward-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-intensity circular clusters (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme left and right distal tips; right tip shows approximately 5-7 individual circular nodes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear streaks visible on the right lobe, including one prominent diagonal rake mark approximately 20% of the lobe width and two smaller horizontal parallel marks near the midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple white rake marks (linear abrasions) on the right lobe; significant barnacle scarring/colonization at both fluke tips; one small dark circular indentation visible on the right medial lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt and pepper' stippling density in the transition zone between the black central fluke body and the white distal patches.
